purpose: Defines the overall system design of doc-link: system boundary, operations and their connections, normal-case sequence, and common invariants, including what may be written to user documents.
summary: System boundary: doc-link handles document IDs, ToC, search, DLID resolution, reference checks, and change-impact candidate notification
Only DLIDs may be written to target documents (frontmatter doc_link_id and heading-end section IDs); links and titles are never written
Table of operations with inputs, results handed downstream, and write boundaries
ToC build order: target fixation, ID check, change detection, info acquisition, reference check, candidate check, commit
Normal-case sequence diagram of index-docs followed by check-impact as a separate operation
Change-impact notification writes nothing; the project management AI rewrites the recorded content hash
Unreadable reference target directories are recorded as absent without blocking ToC commit
Six common invariants: ID independence, directory scan for references, no partial candidate exposure, no stored notification state, bounded reverse references, key isolation
Storage format and cross-key visibility are decided in individual designs
tasks: Designing or revising doc-link operations and their boundaries
Checking what doc-link may write to user documents
Reviewing design consistency against common invariants
Deciding how a failure or notification should be handled in the ToC build flow
title: DES-001 システム全体設計
